exit_conditions.requirement: capability matrix items have source or repeatable experimental evidence
baseline corpus covers major formats and representative rule syntax

architecture, rule runtime, ABI, and testing designs are reviewed
later phases have measurable completion conditions
performance baseline and resource targets are answered

blockers.title: Windows and macOS capability baselines are incomplete
blockers.progress_evidence: docs/research/capability-coverage-report.md and docs/research/data/capability-coverage.json classify all 68 capability rows across four platforms with zero unclassified cells; Linux Qt5 and Linux Qt6 each have 68 runtime-observed rows, zero source-only rows, and zero corpus-gap rows; docs/research/data/qt6-capability-closure-plan.json closes CAP-GAP-007 with 68 evidence-complete rows, including paired depth 64, 33554546 cumulative expanded bytes, and cancellation-prefix evidence for CAP-NEST-009; Windows and macOS each retain 68 platform-missing rows
blockers.closure_evidence: pinned reproducible baselines with no Phase 0 source-only, corpus-missing, platform-missing, or unclassified capability rows

blockers.title: performance baseline, benchmark environment, and resource targets are not frozen
blockers.progress_evidence: docs/research/upstream-performance-baseline.md and docs/research/data/upstream-benchmark-linux-qt5.json establish a pinned five-layer Linux Qt5 warm baseline with 17 warmup and 90 measured direct processes; docs/research/upstream-performance-affinity.md and docs/research/data/upstream-benchmark-linux-qt5-affinity.json add a single WSL2/Linux vCPU run with cpuset.cpus.effective=0 while preserving the short-control partial-RSS boundary; docs/research/upstream-deployment-size.md and docs/research/data/upstream-deployment-size-linux-qt5.json establish ELF, 16-real-file dynamic dependency, and 2268-rule size accounting; Rust paired, cold, physical-core/topology repeated sessions, cross-platform package size, reviewed thresholds, and default limits remain open
blockers.closure_evidence: reviewed benchmark identity, baseline report, and measurable latency, memory, size, and resource-limit targets
